【原视频简介】
Watch how we use advanced CNC machining, precision tooling, and multi-axis toolpaths to create perfect internal corners inside a part with twisted, warped walls. This challenging aluminum machining project demonstrates CNC programming, custom tool geometry, and high-precision manufacturing to produce seemingly impossible geometry all on the YCM CX4 CNC machine.
